title: Soundless Sound
body:
Syntax: perform soundless sound <target>

Description: Mental damage with a chance to impair accuracy.  Usable with any chakra nature. Base damage: 40-48. 65% chance to inflict soundless. The effect lasts 24 seconds before resistance. Unlocks at level 22. Costs 23 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
